title: Start a React Native project properly
tagline: Absolute imports, ESLint, Prettier, and hooks that run them on every commit.
intro: The first hour of a project decides how the next year feels. Set up imports and linting before the first feature, when there is nothing to migrate.

sections.title: Overview
sections.summary: Four layers, each catching what the last one lets through.

blocks.caption: From an empty folder to a commit that cannot break the style.

items.label: Create the app
items.detail: The React Native CLI scaffolds the native projects and Metro in one command
explain: npx react-native init ProjectName writes the ios and android folders, the JS entry and the Metro config.
yarn start runs Metro, the bundler; yarn android or yarn ios builds the native app and points it at Metro.

items.label: Absolute imports
items.detail: tsconfig tells the editor where imports resolve; Babel tells Metro the same thing
explain: Both are needed. tsconfig paths alone make the editor happy and the bundle fail, because Metro never reads tsconfig.
With root ./src, import Button from 'components/Button' replaces '../../../components/Button' wherever the file is.

items.label: ESLint + Prettier
items.detail: ESLint finds bugs, Prettier fixes layout, and eslint-config-prettier stops them arguing
explain: ESLint's own formatting rules clash with Prettier's output. Putting "prettier" last in extends switches those rules off.
A lint script in package.json gives CI and people the same command: eslint src/**/*.{js,tsx}.

items.label: Husky + lint-staged
items.detail: A pre-commit hook formats and lints only the staged files, so commits stay fast
explain: Husky installs the git hook; lint-staged decides which files it touches, so a one-line fix does not lint the whole repo.
The hook runs npx lint-staged. A lint error blocks the commit, which is the point: bad code never reaches the branch.

sections.title: Absolute imports
sections.summary: Two files, then a cache reset.

blocks.caption: babel.config.js — older projects name the preset metro-react-native-babel-preset

body: Metro caches the old resolution. Delete node_modules, reinstall and run yarn start --reset-cache, or imports keep failing for no visible reason.

blocks.caption: Delete the template's .eslintrc.js first, then answer the init prompts
Husky 9; older guides use husky install and husky add
In package.json; the globs assume all code lives in src
